opcoes.a: rolls-royce onchain before my coffee even finished. what a timeline
opcoes.b: listing 200 names is the easy half. the other half is a book deep enough to fill them at 2am - thats the part we build for
opcoes.c: US capital markets were the warm-up round. europe just got the same treatment and nobody repriced their weekend yet

items.pt: Bancos da Anthropic preparam subir a avaliacao do IPO para US$ 1,5 trilhao ou mais, segundo o FT. E a escalada de ontem com numero novo; usado so como reply, com fonte atribuida (nao vai como post).

opcoes.a: 1.5T before the first earnings call. confidence is a currency too i guess
opcoes.b: every repricing like this is a bet on who gets the upside early. queuing for an allocation vs hitting a book - different sports entirely
opcoes.c: a trillion-dollar number decided by bankers in a room at 1am. the market that never closes has opinions about that

items.pt: Fechamento do painel Agents on the Order Book no Web Summit Lisboa: fluxos de trading com IA que fiquem transparentes e auditaveis. Parceiro, e o angulo de execucao e o nosso.

opcoes.a: an AI agent trading your book and a human trading your book share one failure mode: nobody checked the fill
opcoes.b: agents need a book that answers in milliseconds, not a favour list. execution is the product, whatever writes the order
opcoes.c: everyone wants an AI agent until it routes through a pool with no depth. inspectable is the right word, ngl

items.pt: ZEC caiu abaixo de US$ 1.000 e um trader com long 10x de 18.000 ZEC (US$ 17,63 mi) esta com mais de US$ 2,8 mi de prejuizo e liquidacao em US$ 895,46. Puro prato de reply, sem conselho.

opcoes.a: down 2.8M and the liquidation line is a hundred dollars away. thats not a position thats a countdown
opcoes.b: 10x on anything is also a bet on the venue being fast enough to save you. speed is the feature nobody checks
opcoes.c: every cycle someone discovers leverage has a timetable and it is never theirs

items.pt: Bybit lancou vouchers de protecao para Copy Trading, cobrindo ate 100 USDT de perda elegivel. Post de 3 minutos atras: melhor janela de reply do bloco e o tema e risco, nao promocao.

opcoes.a: insurance for copy trading is basically paying someone to hold your hand while you press the button. respect tho
opcoes.b: cover for losses and cover for bad fills are different products. the second one is just called liquidity
opcoes.c: we now insure the copying but not the decision to copy. the interesting risk is the one nobody sells cover for
